builtin:sine.instrument: Built-in sine synth: a plain placeholder tone that always works
tips: Use it to sketch a part, then switch the track to a real plugin.

builtin:drums.instrument: Built-in synthesized drum kit (General MIDI note layout)
tips: Note length is ignored: every hit plays its full sound.
Vary hi-hat velocities (0.4-0.9) to avoid a mechanical feel.
For realistic drums use builtin:sampler with your own one-shot samples.

builtin:sampler.instrument: Built-in one-shot sampler: maps MIDI notes to audio files
tips: Pass samples as {"36": "C:/path/kick.wav", "38": "C:/path/snare.wav"} when adding the track.
Each note plays its whole file once; note length and pitch are ignored.
